headword: {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}

definitions.explanation: The maximum number of people that a venue, facility, or vehicle can hold or accommodate.

examples.japanese: この{会場|かいじょう}の{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}は{千人|せんにん}だ。
examples.english: This venue has a capacity of one thousand people.

examples.japanese: {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}を{超|こ}えると{危険|きけん}です。
examples.english: It is dangerous to exceed the capacity.

examples.japanese: スタジアムの{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}は{五万人|ごまんにん}で、{日本|にほん}でも{最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{規模|きぼ}だ。
examples.english: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand, making it one of the largest in Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when discussing venues, buildings, stadiums, theaters, and transportation. Often appears in event planning and building regulations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}は〜{人|にん} (has a capacity of ~ people)
- {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}を{超|こ}える (to exceed capacity)
- {最大|さいだい}{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう} (maximum capacity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定員|ていいん}: fixed capacity — the officially set maximum number of people
